queue.what: Regional and national LTL carrier that offers final-mile, residential and white-glove delivery of bulky and heavy items that don't suit small-parcel networks.
Family-owned national LTL carrier whose Final Mile service delivers freight curbside or to the doorstep at residences and businesses for e-commerce shippers.
Regional LTL and logistics carrier that took a minority stake in the big-and-bulky final-mile provider Aria Logistics in 2023.
New Jersey-based 3PL running a national final-mile network for home delivery of big and bulky items such as appliances, furniture and fitness equipment.
Truckload, intermodal and logistics provider in North America that also sells final-mile delivery and ground expedite services (Universal ON-DEMAND).
